description: Create a new volume. Either location or assignee must be provided to determine placement.

assignee.description: Resource to attach the volume to once created; the volume is created in its location

automount.description: Auto-mount the volume after attaching it to the assignee

location.description: Location name (e.g. "fsn1"). Required if no assignee is set

server.description: Deprecated alias for assignee {id: server, type: "server"}; do not combine with assignee

size.description: Size of the volume in GB

name: hetzner_create_volume
title: Create Volume
